description: Uptime monitors (is a site, API, port or cron job up or down), read now. Without uuid: every uptime monitor's status (up, down, paused, waiting for its first check) and since when, uptime over 24 hours and 30 days, average response time, incidents in 30 days, the open incidents and the latest ones with their cause and duration; search narrows it to names or addresses. With uuid: that monitor in full, with uptime over 24 hours, 7, 30 and 90 days, response times, its last incidents with causes and durations, the certificate's expiry and, for a heartbeat, its URL (with write access). Use it for 'is my site up?', 'which sites were down this week?' and 'how is my API doing?'. Page-change tasks are read with the other monitor tools.

search.description: Only monitors whose name or address contains this, case insensitive

uuid.description: One uptime monitor (from this tool without uuid, or list_monitors)
